description:
Situated in one of the city's most coveted areas, this substantial detached family home offers a blend of elegance and practicality. The spacious living room boasts a feature fireplace and a charming box bay window, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The fitted kitchen seamlessly flows into a sitting room that overlooks the rear garden, perfect for relaxing and entertaining. The generous master bedroom includes a dressing area and ensuite bathroom, providing a luxurious retreat. Three additional bedrooms and a shower room offer ample space for family and guests. Complete with a garage and a versatile outbuilding that was previously used as a home office, this property is set on a large plot of approximately a quarter of an acre. The convenient location provides easy access to local amenities, including a primary school, public house, supermarket, and mini market, as well as excellent transport links to the city centre and major roadways. Don't miss the opportunity to call this exceptional property your new home.

Directions From Carlisle city centre head north on the A7 (Scotland Road) over Eden Bridge past Carlisle Cricket Club, taking the second left onto St. Georges Crescent.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • The property is in a conservation zone. • St Georges Crescent is an unadopted road.
